text: Nobody tells you these six stocks pay you every year.
Coal India pays about six point six percent. One lakh gives you around sixty six hundred rupees a year.
Vipro, five point nine percent. O. N. G. C., five point seven.
Indian Oil, five and a half. B. P. C. L., five point four. And I. T. C., five point one.
But here's the catch. Dividends are taxed at your slab rate. And a high yield can simply mean the price fell.
Dividends are never guaranteed. A company can cut them any year.
Which one do you hold? Comment DIVIDEND, and follow for more.
